author: Wintergatan
description:
Welcome to a new season of the Marble Machine project, where I’m actually getting serious about doing what I need to do to give the project a chance of success. It’s a psychological battle against my own limitations, but I will take the ring to Mordor, and Sam is with me for the journey.

It’s time to overcome my perfectionism and build a simpler, more beautiful machine that I can actually finish. I’m locking in - let’s build a smarter Marble Machine.
